messageExpiryEnabled.description: When enabled, you can set the deletion conditions for expired messages.

numberOfDaysForMessageExpiry.description: Number of days after which messages expire.

strictDeletionEnabled.description: When enabled, all read and unread voicemail messages will be deleted based on the time frame you set. When disabled, all unread voicemail messages will be kept.

voiceMessageForwardingEnabled.description: When enabled, people in the organization can configure the email forwarding of voicemails.
